record.description: One record the space's change feed currently describes, with its repo and the op the fold applied.

repo.description: The repo the folded record belongs to. An edit of an author's record resolves to the author's repo, not the space's.

record.description: The lexicon record: its $type, its createdAt from the log's ordering stamp, and its fields.

op.description: Whether one change produced the record (create) or it has been rewritten since (update).

main.description: Page a space's change feed as the current records it describes. Admin-only. The feed is partitioned by the space's stream in the event-log DB and folded on read; the cursor carries the snapshot the page was folded under, so pagination is stable while the space is written to.

repo.description: Return only records whose folded repo is this DID.

collection.description: Return only records of this collection.

cursor.description: The cursor returned by the previous page. Replay it with the same repo and collection.
Present when more records follow; absent on the last page.
